findings.class: contradicts sibling ID: check goes red on the pattern a sibling rule mandates
findings.evidence: Plant: Sources/Stdio.swift holding the SW-LANG-02 'right' snippet (swift-format-ignore-file line, then #if canImport(Glibc) / @preconcurrency import Glibc / Musl / Darwin, then import Foundation). `bash k07.sh` in a git repo exits 1 and prints 4 lines: the swift-format-ignore-file line and the three '@preconcurrency import' lines (hatches() regex has no libc carve-out). SW-CONC-10 says '@preconcurrency import X' is allowed for libc/OS shims with no comment, and SW-LANG-02 and SW-CLI-07 require it. Gate step 1c therefore cannot go green on a compliant CLI unless the author adds a prose comment the sibling rule says is unneeded. The same hatch noise shows on 5 real trees: nio prints about 100 '@preconcurrency import Glibc/Musl/Bionic/Android' lines.
findings.fix: In hatches() awk, skip a line when it matches /^[[:space:]]*@preconcurrency[[:space:]]+import[[:space:]]+(Glibc|Musl|WASILibc|Android|Bionic|Darwin|CRT|WinSDK|Dispatch|EmscriptenLibc)([[:space:]]|$)/ (the SW-CONC-10 allow-list), and add one header line saying so. Re-run the Stdio.swift plant: expect only the swift-format-ignore-file line (an E15 PR-justification item). Also edit the SW-LANG-02 snippet (language.md) so the example is not red: drop the swift-format-ignore-file line or say E15 needs a PR reason for it.

findings.class: check coverage narrower than the rule text it enforces
findings.evidence: SW-CORE-01 lists 'a raised timeout-minutes' as weakening. Fixture .github/workflows/ci.yml with 'timeout-minutes: 10' committed; change it to 45: `BASE=main bash weaken-check.sh` prints 0 lines, exit 0 (green). Only 100 or more is caught (regex `timeout-minutes: *[0-9]{3,}`); 10 to 100 printed 1 line. `swiftLanguageModes: [.v6, .v5]` and `swiftLanguageVersions: [.v5]` also print 0 lines against the '.v5 opt-out' item (only `[.v5` as the first element and `swiftLanguageMode(.v5)` match). silence-check.sh has the same hole for `timeout 60` and `timeout 30m` (regex `timeout [0-9]{3,}`).
findings.fix: Detect a raise as a numeric delta, or flag every changed timeout line. Replace the timeout alternative with `timeout-minutes:` on both - and + lines, e.g. add `-e '^[-+][[:space:]]*timeout-minutes:'` (print both sides so a reviewer sees the old and new value). Widen the v5 alternative to `swiftLanguage(Modes|Versions): *\[[^]]*\.v5`. For silence-check use `timeout[ =][0-9]+` and `\.timeLimit\(` added lines. Add a plant per enumerated SW-CORE-01 item to the 'Watched red' sentence.

findings.class: contradicts sibling ID: check goes red on the pattern a sibling rule mandates
findings.evidence: Adding the canonical SW-LANG-02 libc chain (3 lines '@preconcurrency import Glibc/Musl/Darwin') in a new Stdio.swift makes `BASE=main bash weaken-check.sh` print 3 lines, exit 1. SW-CONC-10 allows these with no reason. Output also carries no file path (the '+++ ' headers are stripped), so a reviewer cannot tell which file each of the lines belongs to. Removed-line regex hits Swift source: deleting `func sanitizeForTerminal` printed 1 line, exit 1 (alternatives 'sanitize', 'Werror', '--strict' match ordinary code).
findings.fix: Apply the same libc allow-list as k07 (skip '^\+[[:space:]]*@preconcurrency[[:space:]]+import[[:space:]]+(Glibc|Musl|...)'). Restrict the '^-' (removed-gate) alternative to non-Swift pathspecs (run it as a second git diff over '*.yml' '*.yaml' Makefile '*/Makefile' '*.sh' Dockerfile '*/Dockerfile'). Print FILE: before each line (awk tracking '^+++ b/').

findings.class: diff scoping error (two-dot, untracked files, shallow clone)
findings.evidence: hatch-delta (`git diff -U0 "$BASE" -- '*.swift' | awk ...`): fixture with a tracked edit adding 2 hatches plus an untracked new b.swift containing `Task.detached` printed only the 2 tracked lines, so the new-file hatch is missed. Branch-behind case (hd2 fixture: feat branched from main, main later deleted an @unchecked Sendable line): the two-dot form prints `+final class A: @unchecked Sendable {}` on feat although feat added nothing, and `git diff -U0 --merge-base main` prints nothing. Every sibling script (weaken-check, k07, generated-touch) already uses `git add -N .` plus --merge-base for exactly these two reasons.
findings.fix: Replace the hatch-delta line (index line 133) with: `git add -N . && git diff -U0 --merge-base "$BASE" -- '*.swift' | awk '/^\+[^+]/ && /@unchecked[[:space:]]+Sendable|nonisolated\(unsafe\)|Task\.detached|@preconcurrency|MainActor\.assumeIsolated|MainActor\.run/'` and say in the comment that it stages intent-to-add only.

findings.class: awk state never resets, false negative
findings.evidence: Package@swift-6.0.swift: `for target in package.targets { target.swiftSettings = [] }` on line 2, then line 3 `package.targets.forEach { $0.swiftSettings = [.enableUpcomingFeature("Y")] }`: `bash fold-check.sh` exits 0 with no output (inloop is set at the loop head and never cleared, so everything after the loop counts as inside it). Either narrow the rule text to 'inside the loop or in a shared array it applies to every target' or add a note: 'expect hits on a manifest that keeps one shared swiftSettings array; justify in the PR'.
